card.line: Babylon was a great city on the Euphrates and the capital of Nebuchadnezzar's empire, where many people of Judah were taken into exile, some years before Jerusalem's final fall.

moments.title: Jehoiachin Taken Captive
moments.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against Jerusalem, and King Jehoiachin surrendered. Nebuchadnezzar carried him, the royal family, and the leading men away to Babylon.

moments.title: Zedekiah Brought to Babylon
moments.text: After Zedekiah rebelled, Nebuchadnezzar marched against Jerusalem again. The Chaldeans seized Zedekiah, judged him at Riblah, and then took him to Babylon in bronze shackles.

moments.title: A Letter to the Exiles
moments.text: Jeremiah sent a letter from Jerusalem to the exiles who had been carried to Babylon. It said that when Babylon's seventy years were complete, the LORD would restore them to their home.

moments.title: Daniel Pleads for the Wise Men
moments.text: The king was so angry that he ordered all the wise men of Babylon destroyed. Daniel answered with tact, asked his friends to plead for God's mercy, and then asked Arioch not to execute the wise men.

moments.title: Rulers Over the Province
moments.text: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to manage the province of Babylon, while Daniel remained in the king's court.
